usedFor: Qmize WhatsApp API sends “Send WhatsApp Template Message” to a phone number through your Qmize WhatsApp API account.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting” in Google Meet, then “Send WhatsApp Template Message” in Qmize WhatsApp API
bestTemplate.why: A new meeting can start a template message to a phone number.

watchOut: This message reaches someone outside, so it waits in Needs you for approval first.
